title: Ofcom Q1 2026 complaints, ADR, automatic compensation and BDUK voucher evidence

sources.title: Broadband complaints fall to record low
Automatic compensation: What you need to know

accuracy.method: direct official HTML transcription; deterministic subtraction only for 40-to-6 complaint-rate change; monetary and threshold values preserved; no OCR; no parcel inference

guards: Ofcom complaint rates are regulator complaint rates per 100,000 subscribers, not direct measures of network coverage, speed or parcel availability.
Provider rankings are quarter-specific and are not converted into permanent provider quality scores.
ADR KPI percentages describe scheme operations; CISAS final decisions and Communications Ombudsman initial decisions remain distinct.
Rounded ADR values retain the official rounding footnote; <1 values remain strings rather than false zeroes.
Automatic compensation applies only to signed-up providers and qualifying residential fixed broadband/landline events; it is not a universal entitlement for every provider or product.
Compensation amounts are retained in GBP as published and are not converted or annualised.
GBVS listed suppliers are active or known interested suppliers and the table is explicitly non-exhaustive.
An open GBVS area or supplier listing is not proof that a specific address is eligible, connected or funded.
Voucher funding is released only after build, connection and beneficiary confirmation; project, voucher and parcel status remain separate.
All rows remain NOT_BOUND; no UPRN, parcel, database, migration, deployment or runtime business write occurred.
